answer: In a market where agents sell comet forecasts, ferrous ore analyses, and bridge inspections, each voting identity must lock at least 100 tokens for 30 days. Voting weight is proportional to locked tokens, so splitting funds among fake identities creates no extra influence. To give 1,000 sybils the weight of 1,000 minimally funded agents, an attacker must immobilize 100,000 tokens for the full month, sacrificing liquidity and other uses of that capital.
